**Test each xerophytic feature against the image**

Sunken stomata appear as pits recessed below the surface to trap moist air, and those lower dips fit this. A thick cuticle appears as a distinct dark, thickened outer layer, which is clearly visible here.

Plants have epidermis, not epithelium, which is an animal tissue term. Surface area to volume ratio is a property of the whole 3D leaf, you cannot measure it from one transverse section.
